description:
Join a team that powers the business enterprise behind the mission. Freedom supports the sustainment, modernization, and transformation of more than 100 enterprise business systems that enable tens of thousands of government personnel, industry partners, and prospective employees worldwide. Our teams develop, modernize, secure, and operate the applications and services that support workforce management, training, financial operations, acquisitions, security processing, and executive decision-making across multiple secure environments.       

 As part of this program, you will work alongside experts in software engineering, cloud computing, DevSecOps, systems engineering, and enterprise platforms to modernize legacy systems, automate business processes, and deliver innovative solutions that improve efficiency, reduce costs, and enhance the user experience. The work you perform will help ensure the organization has the technology, information, and capabilities needed to support its workforce and accomplish its mission.    

 Join a team that powers the business enterprise behind the mission. Freedom supports the sustainment, modernization, and transformation of more than 100 enterprise business systems that enable tens of thousands of government personnel, industry partners, and prospective employees worldwide. These mission-enabling applications support workforce management, finance, acquisitions, security processing, training, recruitment, logistics, program management, executive decision-making, and other critical business functions across multiple secure environments.    

 We are seeking a  SQL Software Developer  to support and enhance a corporate solution that integrates budgeting and other financial information across the enterprise. In this role, you will work directly with customers, technical leads, Systems Engineers, and other development teams to deliver solutions that improve the reliability, performance, and maintainability of critical financial systems.   

 The position offers the opportunity to work across the full software development lifecycle – from understanding requirements and defining technical solutions through development, testing, deployment, documentation, and ongoing product support. You will help maintain a legacy production technology stack while identifying opportunities to improve system sustainment, proactively address potential issues, reduce downtime, and streamline the implementation of system upgrades. This is a collaborative, customer-facing role that requires the ability to work across interconnected applications and teams with shared technical dependencies. The successful candidate will be comfortable solving complex technical problems, working in an Agile environment, and balancing modernization and new development efforts with the operational needs of production systems.   

 Primary Responsibilities:   

 
 Develop, enhance, and support enterprise SQL-based applications and database components that integrate critical budgeting and financial information, including troubleshooting complex issues within a legacy production environment.   

 Work directly with customers, technical leads, and System Engineers to understand requirements, define technical outcomes, develop solutions, and deliver enhancements that address business and operational needs.   

 Manage development and sustainment work through JIRA while participating in requirements analysis, design, development, testing, deployment, troubleshooting and ongoing support.   

 Collaborate with multiple technical and development teams across the task order to coordinate shared dependencies, resolve cross-application impacts, and successfully implement changes across interconnected systems.   

 Apply software development, design, testing, quality assurance, and DevOps practices to deliver reliable, maintainable solutions and support continuous improvement of development and sustainment processes.   

 Create and maintain technical documentation necessary to support system operations, development, troubleshooting, knowledge transfer, and ongoing system sustainment.    

 Identify and implement opportunities to improve system reliability and operational efficiency, including proactively addressing potential issues, reducing outage duration, streamlining upgrades, and improving the availability and usability of supported systems.   

 
 Technology Stack: 

 
 SQL Server   

 Ironspeed   

 C#   

 React or VueJS   

 JavaScript   

 
 Required Qualifications: 

 
 Twelve (12) years of experience in software development/engineering   
 
 Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university in Computer Science or related discipline   

 Four (4) years of additional software development experience may be substituted for a bachelor’s degree.   

 


 
 
  

 
 
 Experience with Java, Django, ReactJS, Python, JavaScript   

 Willingness to learn new technologies   

 Experience developing and updating technical documentation     

 Ability to collaborate with other teams and dev stacks   

 
 Desired Qualifications: 

 
 Experience working in an Agile Development  environment   

 Experience managing the full software development lifecycle (SDLC) to include requirements definition, design, development, test, deployment, and sustainment   

 Experience managing systems in a virtual hosting environment including AWS   

 Experience with SQL Server   

 Experience with C#   

 
 The estimated salary range for this position is between $260,000-$265,000 (annualized USD). This range reflects the typical pay for the role and is one part of the company's comprehensive compensation package. Actual salaries are influenced by several factors, such as location, the individual’s education, skills, experience, and competencies, as well as contract affordability and organizational needs. 
  

 What’s in It for You? 

 Flexible work environment

 A team mentality – work with friendly, like-minded professionals

 Work with innovative, cutting edge technologies

 Enjoy extremely competitive compensation and benefits

 A work-life balance you can count on

 Opportunities to grow and advance your career on our dime

  

 The Benefits You Get with Freedom 

 Amazing benefits including matching 401k, fully paid medical, and more

 Generous paid time off – including paid site closure days

 Competitive salary offerings

 Paid training and tuition reimbursement

 Referral bonuses

 Fully paid life and disability

 Annual logo wear allowance

 Company sponsored events (game nights, holiday party, summer party, happy hours)

 Interested in learning more about Freedom and our culture?  Contact us today!  We’re constantly hosting hiring events in our office and elsewhere, to help you get a sense of what life is like at Freedom before joining the team.
